title: An actual eight-mode field now obstructs ordinary heat on a small-r interval
statement: Completed solo producer Theorem D and exact source report: psi=-cos(x)+(1/1000)sin(x)^6 cos(y) has eight real Fourier modes. For EVERY 0<r<=10^-9, the time-zero ordinary-heat derivative of <P_(r,1)(D2 exp(s Delta)psi)> is strictly positive. Multiplying by the positive denominator 8r(r+1)^2(r+2)^2 gives a degree-seven polynomial whose eight scalar Bernstein coefficients on [0,10^-9] are strictly positive. The endpoint derivative is approximately 3.218; exact rational values are recorded. Energy is positive and the original cubic average is zero. Thus no legitimate globally closed correction can make THIS original functional's ordinary-heat density PSD over its full compatible value/jet domain on this interval. This is a concrete method obstruction, NOT QC failure or a negative instance of the original inequality. Other diffusions and nonlinear/nonlocal arguments remain possible. Earlier numerical fits or failures at .73,.75,.8,.9 were proposals, some solver-inaccurate, and did not refute the whole method or all r<1. The later completed producer theorem covers finite r>=3/4. The rescaled r->infinity Gram endpoint alone is not an unscaled variational theorem. The PR307 det-squared heat obstruction does not exclude functional-specific certificates. The scalar range 0<r<3/4, general U, full affine QC and Morrey separation remain unresolved. heat_obstruction.py imports the final receive.py; both are acquired and neither was executed by Capital.
